text:
morgan: Quick perf snapshot (attached) for L4/T4/A10 vs A100/H100 across seq-len 32/256/1024 and batch sizes 1/8. TL;DR: L4/T4 prefer 'micro' kernel under 128 tokens; above 512 we flip to 'wide-fused' but see 3x more KV cache misses and p95 regresses on small-batch chat workloads. Link: https://perf.redwood/reports/2173456789
brad: Nice — can you paste the top flame graph or a few numbers? I suspect the dispatch threshold is too aggressive on Ampere-like devices.
morgan: top numbers:
```
L4 seq32 b1: p95 42ms (micro)
L4 seq1024 b1: p95 210ms (wide-fused), KV-miss rate +3x
A100 seq1024 b1: p95 180ms (fused)
H100 seq1024 b1: p95 170ms (fused stays faster until ~768)
```
carla: We've seen similar. On A100 batch1 fused dominates earlier than on L4. Suggest making thresholds device-family-aware and add a quick runtime probe on model load to pick the local best kernel.
brad: +1. Proposed policy (quick sketch):
```
device_preset:
  l4_family: {swap_at: 256, prefer: [micro, wide]}
  a100_family: {swap_at: 512, prefer: [fused, wide]}
  h100_family: {swap_at: 768, prefer: [fused]}
runtime_probe: tokens=1000, measure=p95, pick_best=true
``` 
morgan: After running that mapping in staging: L4 p95 down 12% on chat-smoke, H100 unchanged. Caveat: KV eviction rate on L4 increased ~20% (we're thrashing cache due to kernel memory working set differences).
perf-bot: perf-regression-checker: created alert #perf-regen for p95 regressions >8% and KV-miss >15% on the route.
carla: Can we canary this? 5% traffic for 24h, auto-rollback if p95 >5% or KV-miss >10%.
brad: sounds good, add an AB test with rollback hook and extra tracing for KV evictions.
morgan: I'll open a tiny PR with the device_family mapping + probe and schedule the canary. Will drop raw counters & flame graphs here in ~2h. :thumbsup:
